automation_events.origin: AE7 (2026-11-08), James: "Then an api that eravos can use for the step. So needs full cli commands, events, nodes."
automation_events.pipelines: AE5 (0.60.462): automation.pipeline.start { pipelineId, runId } · automation.pipeline.task { pipelineId, runId, task, label, status, ms?, error?, output? (what passed, a preview), gate? { type, outcome: open|closed|gap, why, saw, held, actions } — PC4/PC5 0.60.466 } · automation.pipeline.done { pipelineId, runId, status } · automation.pipeline.created { pipelineId, name } · PC8 slice a (2026-11-10): automation.pipeline.task also carries startedAt, finishedAt and waitMs (the delta after the steps it waits on); automation.pipeline.decision { pipelineId, pipeline, runId, task, decision { by: 'raid', kind, asked, chose, command, why, at, task, attempt } } is a decision taken during a step (RAID choosing the agent), kept on the run as run.decisions and on its task.
automation_events.triggers_hear: BrainOS migrated, 2026-11-09 (his: "Also conditions, triggers, events, etc. migrate BrainOS’ features to the engine."): an event trigger hears cos.ledger (subject "<system> <kind>"), pipeline.request.met | held | not_met | cancelled (subject: the pipeline’s name), pipeline.gate.closed | gap (subject "<pipeline>/<task>"), any event a system sends by POST /api/cos/automation/events, and Clear Glass’s own (page.visited, download.done, app.start) where it runs. A pipeline step can carry a condition (when: { left, op, value }); false, it is skipped, and so are the steps after it unless a step they wait on ran.

routes.in: { by, mode: update | keep-local, resolve?: fix, backupWith?: git }
routes.out: the update applied (a backup first, asked of Idearium), then each changed system restarted by itself; Clear Glass waits for him (waitForHim); keep-local keeps local commits on local/<date> first (CE2, CE3, 2026-11-02). UP14 (2026-11-10): a conflict (edits here to files GitHub changed, or commits GitHub lacks) answers 409 { ask: conflict, conflict { text, files, commits, fix } }; resolve: fix keeps his on local/<date> and takes GitHub's. No backup answers 409 { ask: no-backup }; backupWith: git backs up as a backup/<date> branch plus a patch of uncommitted edits
